questions.question: Dr. Amrani, now a national management reference, is invited to an international congress. What message should he carry?
options: Management is an art in service of the practice
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Management is an art in service of the practice, combining rigor and vision.' Dr. Bennani: 'I am proud of you.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create a foundation to promote dental management. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Promoting management and practice sustainability is essential for the future of the profession.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will support this foundation.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must write a reference book on dental management. What is the central message?
options: Management is an art that combines rigor, vision, and humanity
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Management is an art that combines rigor, vision, and humanity.' Dr. Bennani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must give a closing speech at an international congress. What note should she leave?
options: Management is evolving, full of opportunities
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Management is evolving, and opportunities are numerous for those who engage.' Dr. Amrani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must create a management mentoring program. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Mentoring transmits fundamental management values.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will support this program.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must manage the succession of her management practice. What is the best strategy?
options: Gradually prepare the transmission of management values
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Gradual preparation of the transmission of management values is the key to a successful succession.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will help you.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must create a management charter for dental practices. What is the fundamental pillar?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Practice sustainability is the pillar of any professional management.' Dr. Bennani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must train future management mentors. What is the first message to convey?
options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of management values
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission of management values.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must prepare a testimony on his management journey. What is the most striking element?
options: Human encounters that shaped his management values
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Human encounters are the most striking moments of a professional life.' Dr. Bennani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create an alumni association in management. What is the main objective?
options: Maintain the link and foster mutual support in management
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Mutual support and the link are the driving forces of an alumni association in management.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will support this association.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must write an article on the future of dental management. What trend should be highlighted?
options: Digital innovation in service of management
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Digital innovation must serve practice management.' Dr. Bennani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create a quality label for practices in management. What are the main criteria?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Management rigor, transparency, and sustainability are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Amrani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must give a farewell speech to the profession. What message should he leave?
options: The profession needs passionate and visionary managers
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The profession needs passionate and visionary managers.' Dr. Bennani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create an award for young dentist-managers. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Excellence in management is the driving force of the profession's evolution.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must write his memoirs. What is the common thread to highlight?
options: The passion for management and encounters with patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'The passion for management and encounters with patients are the common thread of a professional life.' Dr. Bennani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create a management training center. What is the vision?
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Training must produce rigorous and visionary professionals.' Dr. Amrani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must leave a legacy to the profession. What is the most beautiful legacy?
options: Management values and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Management values and the example are the most beautiful legacy one can leave.' Dr. Bennani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must write a letter to future dentists about management. What message should she convey?
options: Management is an exciting discipline with a promising future
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Management is an exciting discipline with a promising future.' Dr. Amrani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must create a scholarship for management students. What is the main objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Supporting deserving students is an investment for the future of management.' Dr. Bennani: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must give a closing speech. What note should she leave?
options: Management continues to evolve with those who carry it
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Management continues to evolve thanks to those who carry it.' Dr. Amrani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must transfer his management practice. What is the priority?
options: Transfer in the continuity of management values
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Transfer in the continuity of management values is the most beautiful success.' Dr. Bennani: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must create a peer network for young managers. What is the objective?
options: Foster mutual support and sharing of management experiences
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Mutual support and sharing are essential for young managers.' Dr. Amrani: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani must write a conclusion to his book. What is the final sentence?
options: Management is a magnificent human adventure
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani explains: 'Management is a magnificent human adventure.' Dr. Bennani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Bennani must leave a message to future generations. What is the message?
options: Management is a discipline worth experiencing
questions.explanation: Dr. Bennani explains: 'Management is a discipline worth experiencing.' Dr. Amrani: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Amrani, after a life dedicated to management, receives national recognition. Dr. Bennani is by his side. What is Dr. Amrani's message to young dentists?
questions.explanation: Dr. Amrani concludes: 'Management needs passion and dedication to continue evolving.' Dr. Bennani: 'I am proud of you.'
